<function name="SetIcon" parent="DTree_Node" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets the material for the icon of the <page>DTree_Node</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="path" type="string">The path to the material to be used. Do not include "materials/". .pngs are supported.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
